Classical.historicalSetting: Belavadós flourishes and serves most historical TTRPG campaigns. The archive records a Dawn of Steam around 65 CE; steam-assisted agriculture by 78 CE; major arcano-industrial workshops during 91–115 CE; skyships during roughly 105–120 CE; and railway networks from about 115–135 CE. By later Classical, public transport becomes a world-backed necessity: skyships, trains, submarines, ferries, caravans and interworld portals link islands, cities, lands and continents. Aza'raan translation equivalents for these six English terms must come from the language canon, not invented here. Earth portals remain multiple: some survive, others close or are forgotten. The Veilgate exists throughout. The City of the Mourned Gods does NOT. Nephthysra is born in 140 CE, and their descendants cannot precede that date. Late 827 CE is the single binding destruction event: the Iron Dominion's hybrid antimatter/dark-matter bomb incorporating ichor mined from Aza'ra destroys Belavadós and ends the Classical era.

The Traditional-era MMORPG takes place amid scarred territory, restoration, and protected dome settlements; the City of the Mourned Gods is founded AFTER the catastrophe and then becomes home to multiple gods, explicitly Anubriosh.
